title: Hire for Attitude or for Experience?

scenes.say: Lots of experience and a good hire sound like the same thing. Often they're not.
You can teach someone to steam milk in a week. Teaching them to care about a guest takes a lot longer.

props.caption: Myth or *fact*?
props.myth: The most experienced one is the best hire
props.fact: Skills can be taught. Attitude is much harder to teach.

scenes.say: In one big study, managers were asked why their new hires didn't work out. Almost nine in ten said attitude, not skill.
So ask about their worst shift. Watch how they treat everyone, not just you. And do a paid trial shift.
